intro1.text: Ahoy there! I'm Pip, your parrot friend! This is Foul Weather, a game built on NEAR. Come on, let me show you how it works!

intro2.text: You run a little shop in a sunny harbor. Sailors are scared of storms, so they pay you to protect their ships.

card.text: Look, here comes a captain! Each one is a real character, with a wallet of their own.

earn.text: The green number is what they pay you. Right now!

lose.text: But the red number is what you pay if the ship sinks. Ouch!

meter.text: This meter tells you if the deal is good. Green is great. Red means, say no!

yes.text: This one is in the green, so let's tap yes!

sailed.text: The ship sets sail, and the coins are ours! See the gold ring on the map? That's our ship!

home.text: She made it! Hooray! Tap the star to collect it. Stars let you decorate your harbor, and every level teaches you a new trick.

lost.text: Oh no... a shipwreck. That's the risk we take. A good shop chooses its ships very carefully.

waiting.text: While the ship sails, everything keeps moving by itself. Prices, fees and captains all change.

spiral1.text: Now for the big one. Every shop in town has paid another shop to help with its risk. But nobody can see the whole chain. And a huge storm is coming...

fall.text: Oh no! One shop can't pay. So the shop that was counting on it can't pay either. They fall like dominoes!

gone1.text: One storm, and those shops are gone. Only the storm was planned. Who fell, and in what order, came from the game's real rules.

gone2.text: Real insurance markets have failed this way. Here, it's a game you can learn from.

live1.text: That was practice, right here in the browser. Now, let's go online! One tap, and the same game opens on NEAR. There's no wallet, and no password. An account is being made for us, right now!

live2.text: We're in! This town is shared with real players, and there's no game server. One NEAR contract holds the rules and all the coins. The captains' wallets have no keys, so only the rules can move their money.

live3.text: I just tapped yes, and it happened on the blockchain, with no popup! There's the receipt, under Last action.

live4.text: Each sea route follows a real price from NEAR Intents, so real markets make the water rough or calm, all by themselves.

end.text: That's Foul Weather. You don't trade the goods. You carry the risk. Now, it's your turn!

c0.text: Ahoy! I'm Pip, your helper. This is your shop. You protect ships!

c1.text: Captains are scared of storms, so they pay you coins to protect their ship.

c2.text: But if the ship sinks, you have to pay for it. Ouch!

c3.text: This meter shows if a deal is good. Green is great. Red means, say no!

c4.text: This looks like a good one. Tap the green button to protect it!

ready.text: Yes! Now the captain gets ready to sail. You get paid when the ship leaves.

ring.text: Hooray! Your ship has a gold ring on the map. Watch it sail!

collect.text: Your ship made it! Tap the star on the map to collect it.

goal.text: Keep going! The shop with the most coins at the Harbor Festival wins.

wreck.text: Oh no... That's the risk of the job. Say no to the red ones, and you'll be fine.

smart.text: Smart! That deal wasn't worth the danger.

outbid.text: Another shop asked for less this time. Don't worry, there are more captains!

closed.text: A rival shop ran out of coins and closed. See the sign on it in town?

build.text: You have enough stars! Tap Build at the top to make your harbor pretty.

back.text: Welcome back! Captains are waiting at your dock.

live.text: You're playing with real people now! Pick a captain, and tap the green button.

spiral.text: Watch the shops on the left! A huge storm is coming, and they all lean on each other.

domino1.text: One shop ran out of coins. But other shops were counting on it!

domino2.text: Now they can't pay either. It's spreading, like falling dominoes!

great.text: A big storm is coming! Be careful which ships you protect.

storm.text: A storm is coming towards your ship! Fingers crossed!

stormshare.text: Storm coming! Your ship is in danger! Shall we share the risk with another shop?

detect.text: Hmm! That ship sank in strange weather. Shall we investigate?

help.text: A captain has run out of coins! Shall we lend them a hand?

level.text: Hooray! You reached a new level!

who.text: Who do you want to be? You can run a shop, or sail your own ship!

roles.text: You can run a shop, or be a captain and sail your own ship. Real players take both sides, and deal with each other!

cap0.text: Ahoy, Captain! This is your very own ship. Let's make some coins!

cap0live.text: Ahoy, Captain! This is your very own ship. The shops here can be real players!

cap1.text: Pick an island. The green number is what you could earn. Then choose how much to pay for protection.

capask.text: Now we wait for the shops to answer. If they say yes, we sail protected.

capbare.text: No protection? Brave! But if we sink, we lose it all.

capsail.text: We're off! Look for your gold ring on the map.

caphome.text: Land ho! Your cargo is sold. Tap the star to collect it.

capwreck.text: Oh no... your ship sank. If a shop protected you, they have to pay you.

capreal.text: A real player just said yes to your ship!

capcaught.text: We got caught! Honest sailors don't sink their own ships.

capbroke.text: We're out of coins... We'll have to wait for a shop to help us.

shopreal.text: This captain is a real player! They want the best deal, and they might even be sneaky.

capintro.text: Now let's see the other side. This time, we'll be a captain!

captrip.text: A captain chooses an island, and how much to pay for protection. Then the shops decide whether to say yes.

capanswers.text: Look, the shops are answering! When one of them is a real player, you'll see their name.

capoff.text: And we're off! Online, every captain and every shop can be a real person, playing with each other.
